mcat_description.short: A swimming pool tensile cover is a custom-fabricated tensile membrane structure — PVC-coated or HDPE/PTFE fabric stretched over a mild steel or aluminium frame — installed over a swimming pool to provide shade, weather protection, and UV resistance. Sold as a complete supply-and-install project, typically quoted per square foot of covered area.
mcat_description.long: Swimming pool tensile covers are architectural membrane structures that use high-tension fabric (most commonly PVC-coated polyester, with HDPE, PTFE, or ETFE as premium alternatives) stretched over a rigid steel or aluminium framework to form a stable, weather-resistant canopy over a pool. The structure is fully custom-fabricated to pool dimensions and can take conical, arch, dome, hypar, or cantilever forms, providing UV protection, waterproofing, and wind resistance while allowing natural light transmission through translucent membranes. In the Indian B2B market, these are sold as turnkey supply-and-install projects by tensile structure fabricators, with fabric GSM (typically 500–1400 GSM), frame material (MS/GI/aluminium), and structural shape as the primary differentiating specifications. Key applications include hotel and resort pools, residential society pools, sports complexes, school pools, and public aquatic centres across India.

market_context: In the Indian B2B market, swimming pool tensile covers are sold as custom-fabricated, supply-and-install structures by specialist tensile structure fabricators concentrated in Delhi-NCR, Pune, Mumbai, Chennai, and Bengaluru. PVC-coated polyester fabric over a mild steel (MS) frame is the dominant commercial form, with fabric weight ranging from 500 GSM to 1400 GSM depending on application; HDPE, PTFE, and ETFE are premium alternatives used for high-end hotel and commercial projects. Structural shapes include conical, dome, arch, hypar, and cantilever forms — all custom-designed to pool dimensions. The product is quoted per square foot of covered area across all observed Indian sellers (≥2 independent sources confirm this). Key performance claims in the Indian market include UV resistance (>95% UV blockage), waterproofing, fire retardancy (DIN 4102 B1/M2 referenced by some sellers), and wind load resistance. Buyers are primarily hotel/resort developers, residential society managers, sports clubs, and pool contractors. No mandatory BIS/IS standard specific to swimming pool tensile covers was found in available sources — structures are generally designed to site-specific wind and load requirements. The category sits within the broader tensile structure fabrication industry in India, which also covers car parking, walkway, and stadium canopies.
